name: What steps are involved in the window leak repair process with Maine Results, Inc.?

mainEntity.name: What steps are involved in the window leak repair process with Maine Results, Inc.?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process begins with an initial consultation where we discuss the symptoms of the leak and schedule an on-site inspection. During the inspection, our team meticulously identifies the source and extent of the water intrusion. Following this, we provide a detailed estimate for the necessary repairs. Once approved, we schedule the work, which typically involves preparing the area, performing the repair using quality materials, and conducting post-repair checks to ensure the leak is resolved. We keep you informed throughout every stage, from initial assessment in areas like Meridian or Eagle to the final walkthrough.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process includes consultation, on-site inspection to find the leak, providing an estimate, performing the repair, and final checks.
